Watch: Keep a close eye on geopolitical developments and any escalation in the Middle East. Also, watch for continued strength in AI-related tech names following Samsung and Microsoft's positive news.

Bottom line: Prioritize risk management on your underperforming and leveraged tech/chip positions amidst market uncertainty.
